name: Lapinette, Calamity of Desolation
text:
Fanfare: Select an enemy follower on the field and banish it. Summon a Bunnies of Desolation.

Evolve: Gain Crest: Lapinette, Calamity of Desolation.
Super-Evolve: Delay the count of your Crest: Lapinette, Calamity of Desolation by 1.
